meta.title: Heart-Gnawing Hesitance
meta.description: Caught in the gap between memories and reality.

units.rawText: It showed a girl in black jumping down from a collapsing building before fleeing the Watchtower with panic in her eyes.
units.displayText: It showed a girl in black jumping down from a collapsing building before fleeing the Watchtower with panic in her eyes.

spans.text: It showed a girl in black jumping down from a collapsing building before fleeing the Watchtower with panic in her eyes.

units.rawText: To think she would get so flustered during her debut performance... It's almost insulting, really.
units.displayText: To think she would get so flustered during her debut performance... It's almost insulting, really.

spans.text: To think she would get so flustered during her debut performance... It's almost insulting, really.

units.rawText: And here I thought she'd have more fun talking with them during their reunion.
units.displayText: And here I thought she'd have more fun talking with them during their reunion.

spans.text: And here I thought she'd have more fun talking with them during their reunion.

units.rawText: Malkira sighs and lightly pats the pet Entropic's head.
units.displayText: Malkira sighs and lightly pats the pet Entropic's head.

spans.text: Malkira sighs and lightly pats the pet Entropic's head.

units.rawText: Our little lamb is lost, it seems. Time to act as her shepherd.
units.displayText: Our little lamb is lost, it seems. Time to act as her shepherd.

spans.text: Our little lamb is lost, it seems. Time to act as her shepherd.

units.rawText: The pet Entropic curls its tentacle up in a yawn and crawls down from Malkira's thigh.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic curls its tentacle up in a yawn and crawls down from Malkira's thigh.

spans.text: The pet Entropic curls its tentacle up in a yawn and crawls down from Malkira's thigh.

units.rawText: Kiki.
units.displayText: Kiki.

spans.text: Kiki.

units.rawText: After a brief reply, it vanishes into the empty, sprawling hall.
units.displayText: After a brief reply, it vanishes into the empty, sprawling hall.

spans.text: After a brief reply, it vanishes into the empty, sprawling hall.

units.rawText: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: A bright yellow flash that seems entirely out of place in Tartarus races through the buildings.
units.displayText: A bright yellow flash that seems entirely out of place in Tartarus races through the buildings.

spans.text: A bright yellow flash that seems entirely out of place in Tartarus races through the buildings.

units.rawText: It's hot, so hot!
units.displayText: It's hot, so hot!

spans.text: It's hot, so hot!

units.rawText: The scorching sensation is centered around her chest. Its origin is the massive stake that is solidly embedded in her flesh.
units.displayText: The scorching sensation is centered around her chest. Its origin is the massive stake that is solidly embedded in her flesh.

spans.text: The scorching sensation is centered around her chest. Its origin is the massive stake that is solidly embedded in her flesh.

units.rawText: Why is this happening... These memories aren't even mine...
units.displayText: Why is this happening... These memories aren't even mine...

spans.text: Why is this happening... These memories aren't even mine...

units.rawText: They're just redundant data, so why does it feel like it actually happened, and swaying my neural cloud...
units.displayText: They're just redundant data, so why does it feel like it actually happened, and swaying my neural cloud...

spans.text: They're just redundant data, so why does it feel like it actually happened, and swaying my neural cloud...

units.rawText: —Persicaria, heal me!
units.displayText: —Persicaria, heal me!

spans.text: —Persicaria, heal me!

units.rawText: Sol...?
units.displayText: Sol...?

spans.text: Sol...?

units.rawText: No, that's wrong, that's not right...
units.displayText: No, that's wrong, that's not right...

spans.text: No, that's wrong, that's not right...

units.rawText: No, no, no...
units.displayText: No, no, no...

spans.text: No, no, no...

units.rawText: I never arranged a signal like that with anyone else.
units.displayText: I never arranged a signal like that with anyone else.

spans.text: I never arranged a signal like that with anyone else.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Admit it... What they said is true.</color>
units.displayText: Admit it... What they said is true.

spans.text: Admit it... What they said is true.

units.rawText: Could it be that all that "redundant data", those "dreams"... they're actually real?
units.displayText: Could it be that all that "redundant data", those "dreams"... they're actually real?

spans.text: Could it be that all that "redundant data", those "dreams"... they're actually real?

units.rawText: <color=orange>Admit it... You can clearly remember the events of the past, you're just pretending that you don't see it...</color>
units.displayText: Admit it... You can clearly remember the events of the past, you're just pretending that you don't see it...

spans.text: Admit it... You can clearly remember the events of the past, you're just pretending that you don't see it...

units.rawText: Could it be that what I'm going through now is the actual dream instead?
units.displayText: Could it be that what I'm going through now is the actual dream instead?

spans.text: Could it be that what I'm going through now is the actual dream instead?

units.rawText: <color=orange>Admit it... Your present self is just a hollow lie...</color>
units.displayText: Admit it... Your present self is just a hollow lie...

spans.text: Admit it... Your present self is just a hollow lie...

units.rawText: The whispering in her ears grow harder and harder to ignore, and it joins the blaze in her chest in consuming Sol's neural cloud.
units.displayText: The whispering in her ears grow harder and harder to ignore, and it joins the blaze in her chest in consuming Sol's neural cloud.

spans.text: The whispering in her ears grow harder and harder to ignore, and it joins the blaze in her chest in consuming Sol's neural cloud.

units.rawText: Could it be that it's really as they said... that I ought to be that "Sol"?
units.displayText: Could it be that it's really as they said... that I ought to be that "Sol"?

spans.text: Could it be that it's really as they said... that I ought to be that "Sol"?

units.rawText: Amidst her confusion, someone appears in front of her.
units.displayText: Amidst her confusion, someone appears in front of her.

spans.text: Amidst her confusion, someone appears in front of her.

units.rawText: She comes face to face with what could be her twin, except her doppelganger's expression is much brighter and sunnier than hers.
units.displayText: She comes face to face with what could be her twin, except her doppelganger's expression is much brighter and sunnier than hers.

spans.text: She comes face to face with what could be her twin, except her doppelganger's expression is much brighter and sunnier than hers.

units.rawText: Oi, you've got some nerve pointing your sword at Persicaria and the Prof when they came all the way to Tartarus to find you.
units.displayText: Oi, you've got some nerve pointing your sword at Persicaria and the Prof when they came all the way to Tartarus to find you.

spans.text: Oi, you've got some nerve pointing your sword at Persicaria and the Prof when they came all the way to Tartarus to find you.

units.rawText: They're your friends, so hurry up and remember them!
units.displayText: They're your friends, so hurry up and remember them!

spans.text: They're your friends, so hurry up and remember them!

units.rawText: Friends... Can people I've never seen before be called friends?
units.displayText: Friends... Can people I've never seen before be called friends?

spans.text: Friends... Can people I've never seen before be called friends?

units.rawText: You know them better than anyone else! Haven't all those dreams you had lay it out clearly for you? They're the ones you swore to protect.
units.displayText: You know them better than anyone else! Haven't all those dreams you had lay it out clearly for you? They're the ones you swore to protect.

spans.text: You know them better than anyone else! Haven't all those dreams you had lay it out clearly for you? They're the ones you swore to protect.

units.rawText: Go on, accept them and return to the Oasis with the Prof...
units.displayText: Go on, accept them and return to the Oasis with the Prof...

spans.text: Go on, accept them and return to the Oasis with the Prof...

units.rawText: An endless stream of fog billows out of the stake in her chest, practically drowning her.
units.displayText: An endless stream of fog billows out of the stake in her chest, practically drowning her.

spans.text: An endless stream of fog billows out of the stake in her chest, practically drowning her.

units.rawText: She struggles and gasps, like she's drowning and fighting for as much air as she can get before she goes below the surface again.
units.displayText: She struggles and gasps, like she's drowning and fighting for as much air as she can get before she goes below the surface again.

spans.text: She struggles and gasps, like she's drowning and fighting for as much air as she can get before she goes below the surface again.

units.rawText: No... I'm not...
units.displayText: No... I'm not...

spans.text: No... I'm not...

units.rawText: If I'm an agent, then what about the Entropized parts of me?
units.displayText: If I'm an agent, then what about the Entropized parts of me?

spans.text: If I'm an agent, then what about the Entropized parts of me?

units.rawText: They said they'd take me back to the Oasis and cleanse a part of me, the part of me that is an Entropic.
units.displayText: They said they'd take me back to the Oasis and cleanse a part of me, the part of me that is an Entropic.

spans.text: They said they'd take me back to the Oasis and cleanse a part of me, the part of me that is an Entropic.

units.rawText: Will I have to listen to them and watch as what I'm doing now and everything I've experienced is wiped away, just like that?
units.displayText: Will I have to listen to them and watch as what I'm doing now and everything I've experienced is wiped away, just like that?

spans.text: Will I have to listen to them and watch as what I'm doing now and everything I've experienced is wiped away, just like that?

units.rawText: What's with this yellow-haired dork anyway?
units.displayText: What's with this yellow-haired dork anyway?

spans.text: What's with this yellow-haired dork anyway?

units.rawText: She just woke up and hasn't reached full functionality yet. Lady Malkira told us to replenish her operands regularly.
units.displayText: She just woke up and hasn't reached full functionality yet. Lady Malkira told us to replenish her operands regularly.

spans.text: She just woke up and hasn't reached full functionality yet. Lady Malkira told us to replenish her operands regularly.

units.rawText: ...Ah, you're So-so, I mean, Sol, right?
units.displayText: ...Ah, you're So-so, I mean, Sol, right?

spans.text: ...Ah, you're So-so, I mean, Sol, right?

units.rawText: Here, we just caught these Lesser Sanctifiers. They're yours. Don't waste time, just eat them.
units.displayText: Here, we just caught these Lesser Sanctifiers. They're yours. Don't waste time, just eat them.

spans.text: Here, we just caught these Lesser Sanctifiers. They're yours. Don't waste time, just eat them.

units.rawText: ...Eat... them...
units.displayText: ...Eat... them...

spans.text: ...Eat... them...

units.rawText: Sol looks at the mechanical carcasses in the hands of the High Order Entropics from where she's lying in a puddle of liquid Entropy. She is at a loss for what to do next.
units.displayText: Sol looks at the mechanical carcasses in the hands of the High Order Entropics from where she's lying in a puddle of liquid Entropy. She is at a loss for what to do next.

spans.text: Sol looks at the mechanical carcasses in the hands of the High Order Entropics from where she's lying in a puddle of liquid Entropy. She is at a loss for what to do next.

units.rawText: However, this confusion lasts for only a moment. Sol feels her hands moving on their own as she clutches at the "food" being handed to her, and then she greedily infects and devours them. The rich supply of operands heals her wounds and allows her weak self to be reborn.
units.displayText: However, this confusion lasts for only a moment. Sol feels her hands moving on their own as she clutches at the "food" being handed to her, and then she greedily infects and devours them. The rich supply of operands heals her wounds and allows her weak self to be reborn.

spans.text: However, this confusion lasts for only a moment. Sol feels her hands moving on their own as she clutches at the "food" being handed to her, and then she greedily infects and devours them. The rich supply of operands heals her wounds and allows her weak self to be reborn.

units.rawText: That's the way. Now eat up; once you're full, you can head to the frontline with us. Don't take too long, otherwise, the Sanctifiers will get in here, and then we'll all be screwed.
units.displayText: That's the way. Now eat up; once you're full, you can head to the frontline with us. Don't take too long, otherwise, the Sanctifiers will get in here, and then we'll all be screwed.

spans.text: That's the way. Now eat up; once you're full, you can head to the frontline with us. Don't take too long, otherwise, the Sanctifiers will get in here, and then we'll all be screwed.

units.rawText: To the frontline?
units.displayText: To the frontline?

spans.text: To the frontline?

units.rawText: Speak not of such folly, Caina. Sol's situation is different from ours; she can't leave Tartarus.
units.displayText: Speak not of such folly, Caina. Sol's situation is different from ours; she can't leave Tartarus.

spans.text: Speak not of such folly, Caina. Sol's situation is different from ours; she can't leave Tartarus.

units.rawText: Oh yeah. You can protect our "home", then.
units.displayText: Oh yeah. You can protect our "home", then.

spans.text: Oh yeah. You can protect our "home", then.

units.rawText: Our "home"...
units.displayText: Our "home"...

spans.text: Our "home"...

units.rawText: Her mind is blank. This word is the only thing remaining, rooted in the depths of her core.
units.displayText: Her mind is blank. This word is the only thing remaining, rooted in the depths of her core.

spans.text: Her mind is blank. This word is the only thing remaining, rooted in the depths of her core.

units.rawText: The red-haired friend beside Sol pats her on the shoulder, as though entrusting her with some great task. The High Order Entropic that's slightly further away nods.
units.displayText: The red-haired friend beside Sol pats her on the shoulder, as though entrusting her with some great task. The High Order Entropic that's slightly further away nods.

spans.text: The red-haired friend beside Sol pats her on the shoulder, as though entrusting her with some great task. The High Order Entropic that's slightly further away nods.

units.rawText: Kiki!
units.displayText: Kiki!

spans.text: Kiki!

units.rawText: A tiny Entropic has crawled onto her hand at some point. It seems interested in the mechanical corpses. She rips off a chunk and feeds it to the tiny Entropic, which happily devours it before nuzzling Sol in an adorable way.
units.displayText: A tiny Entropic has crawled onto her hand at some point. It seems interested in the mechanical corpses. She rips off a chunk and feeds it to the tiny Entropic, which happily devours it before nuzzling Sol in an adorable way.

spans.text: A tiny Entropic has crawled onto her hand at some point. It seems interested in the mechanical corpses. She rips off a chunk and feeds it to the tiny Entropic, which happily devours it before nuzzling Sol in an adorable way.

units.rawText: The soft sensation tugs at her neural cloud. In that moment, she realizes her purpose for existing and feels truly alive.
units.displayText: The soft sensation tugs at her neural cloud. In that moment, she realizes her purpose for existing and feels truly alive.

spans.text: The soft sensation tugs at her neural cloud. In that moment, she realizes her purpose for existing and feels truly alive.

units.rawText: That's right, I'm an Entropic...
units.displayText: That's right, I'm an Entropic...

spans.text: That's right, I'm an Entropic...

units.rawText: She looks toward the tumbled ruins and ancient walls. Hordes of Entropics are slowly crawling between the ruined buildings.
units.displayText: She looks toward the tumbled ruins and ancient walls. Hordes of Entropics are slowly crawling between the ruined buildings.

spans.text: She looks toward the tumbled ruins and ancient walls. Hordes of Entropics are slowly crawling between the ruined buildings.

units.rawText: Suddenly, she feels as though her blood is flowing through every single Entropic. Her kin are part of her; they have unconditional trust and reliance in her, and in turn, her life is expanded infinitely through them.
units.displayText: Suddenly, she feels as though her blood is flowing through every single Entropic. Her kin are part of her; they have unconditional trust and reliance in her, and in turn, her life is expanded infinitely through them.

spans.text: Suddenly, she feels as though her blood is flowing through every single Entropic. Her kin are part of her; they have unconditional trust and reliance in her, and in turn, her life is expanded infinitely through them.

units.rawText: Ever since she was awakened, she has lived with her kind like this for years. This sort of life ought to keep on going.
units.displayText: Ever since she was awakened, she has lived with her kind like this for years. This sort of life ought to keep on going.

spans.text: Ever since she was awakened, she has lived with her kind like this for years. This sort of life ought to keep on going.

units.rawText: This place... is my home.
units.displayText: This place... is my home.

spans.text: This place... is my home.

units.rawText: I must... protect my home.
units.displayText: I must... protect my home.

spans.text: I must... protect my home.

units.rawText: That's right. My memories and experiences and the decision I made to protect what was dear to me back then are by no means fake.
units.displayText: That's right. My memories and experiences and the decision I made to protect what was dear to me back then are by no means fake.

spans.text: That's right. My memories and experiences and the decision I made to protect what was dear to me back then are by no means fake.

units.rawText: Tartarus is my home... And as an Entropic, I will protect my home.
units.displayText: Tartarus is my home... And as an Entropic, I will protect my home.

spans.text: Tartarus is my home... And as an Entropic, I will protect my home.

units.rawText: I will protect... everyone who is important to me... urgh!
units.displayText: I will protect... everyone who is important to me... urgh!

spans.text: I will protect... everyone who is important to me... urgh!

units.rawText: The heat in her chest is still interfering with her neural cloud. She can feel her sense of self fading away under a tidal wave of data, as though it's going to swallow her up in the blink of an eye. All she can do is hold on tight to her senses and try to convince herself.
units.displayText: The heat in her chest is still interfering with her neural cloud. She can feel her sense of self fading away under a tidal wave of data, as though it's going to swallow her up in the blink of an eye. All she can do is hold on tight to her senses and try to convince herself.

spans.text: The heat in her chest is still interfering with her neural cloud. She can feel her sense of self fading away under a tidal wave of data, as though it's going to swallow her up in the blink of an eye. All she can do is hold on tight to her senses and try to convince herself.

units.rawText: <color=red>"I awoke here and lived here. I am an Entropic."</color>
units.displayText: "I awoke here and lived here. I am an Entropic."

spans.text: "I awoke here and lived here. I am an Entropic."

units.rawText: <color=red>"I belong to Tartarus, and I will never betray my home."</color>
units.displayText: "I belong to Tartarus, and I will never betray my home."

spans.text: "I belong to Tartarus, and I will never betray my home."

units.rawText: Those intruders are still moving deeper into Tartarus, I need to stop them...
units.displayText: Those intruders are still moving deeper into Tartarus, I need to stop them...

spans.text: Those intruders are still moving deeper into Tartarus, I need to stop them...

units.rawText: I can't let this redundant data influence me anymore... I have to... I need to fight!
units.displayText: I can't let this redundant data influence me anymore... I have to... I need to fight!

spans.text: I can't let this redundant data influence me anymore... I have to... I need to fight!

units.rawText: The Entropized girl continues muttering to herself, clawing at the burning stake in her chest as she makes to remove the source of the interference with her neural cloud.
units.displayText: The Entropized girl continues muttering to herself, clawing at the burning stake in her chest as she makes to remove the source of the interference with her neural cloud.

spans.text: The Entropized girl continues muttering to herself, clawing at the burning stake in her chest as she makes to remove the source of the interference with her neural cloud.

units.rawText: However, this foreign object is lodged deep inside her body. Every time she tugs on it, her body is wracked by the pain of tearing flesh.
units.displayText: However, this foreign object is lodged deep inside her body. Every time she tugs on it, her body is wracked by the pain of tearing flesh.

spans.text: However, this foreign object is lodged deep inside her body. Every time she tugs on it, her body is wracked by the pain of tearing flesh.

units.rawText: Ugh— Ow...
units.displayText: Ugh— Ow...

spans.text: Ugh— Ow...

units.rawText: The pain intensifies and shoots through her body like lightning bolts.
units.displayText: The pain intensifies and shoots through her body like lightning bolts.

spans.text: The pain intensifies and shoots through her body like lightning bolts.

units.rawText: She pants heavily, then grits her teeth and prepares to pull on it again. However, a purple tentacle places itself between her hand and the stake, preventing her from harming herself.
units.displayText: She pants heavily, then grits her teeth and prepares to pull on it again. However, a purple tentacle places itself between her hand and the stake, preventing her from harming herself.

spans.text: She pants heavily, then grits her teeth and prepares to pull on it again. However, a purple tentacle places itself between her hand and the stake, preventing her from harming herself.

units.rawText: Kiki—
units.displayText: Kiki—

spans.text: Kiki—

units.rawText: A round little octopus-like creature pokes its head out, and Sol's eyes widen in recognition.
units.displayText: A round little octopus-like creature pokes its head out, and Sol's eyes widen in recognition.

spans.text: A round little octopus-like creature pokes its head out, and Sol's eyes widen in recognition.

units.rawText: You?!
units.displayText: You?!

spans.text: You?!

units.rawText: Shouldn't you be by Lady Malkira's side? What are you doing here...
units.displayText: Shouldn't you be by Lady Malkira's side? What are you doing here...

spans.text: Shouldn't you be by Lady Malkira's side? What are you doing here...

units.rawText: Ki!
units.displayText: Ki!

spans.text: Ki!

units.rawText: Hey, a Low Order Entropic like you shouldn't be climbing so high up... Hey, be careful!
units.displayText: Hey, a Low Order Entropic like you shouldn't be climbing so high up... Hey, be careful!

spans.text: Hey, a Low Order Entropic like you shouldn't be climbing so high up... Hey, be careful!

units.rawText: Sol quickly grabs the round little critter before it falls down. With a sigh, she comes to a halt and carefully scoops it into her arms.
units.displayText: Sol quickly grabs the round little critter before it falls down. With a sigh, she comes to a halt and carefully scoops it into her arms.

spans.text: Sol quickly grabs the round little critter before it falls down. With a sigh, she comes to a halt and carefully scoops it into her arms.

units.rawText: I thought I told you not to go running around... Hey, you okay?
units.displayText: I thought I told you not to go running around... Hey, you okay?

spans.text: I thought I told you not to go running around... Hey, you okay?

units.rawText: Kiki...
units.displayText: Kiki...

spans.text: Kiki...

units.rawText: Eh, as long as you're fine. I'll send you back in a bit...
units.displayText: Eh, as long as you're fine. I'll send you back in a bit...

spans.text: Eh, as long as you're fine. I'll send you back in a bit...

units.rawText: Sol bites back the fatigue in her heart and lightly pokes the pet Entropic's face.
units.displayText: Sol bites back the fatigue in her heart and lightly pokes the pet Entropic's face.

spans.text: Sol bites back the fatigue in her heart and lightly pokes the pet Entropic's face.

units.rawText: Kikikiki...
units.displayText: Kikikiki...

spans.text: Kikikiki...

units.rawText: Lady Malkira sent you? To do what exactly?
units.displayText: Lady Malkira sent you? To do what exactly?

spans.text: Lady Malkira sent you? To do what exactly?

units.rawText: Did I make her worry again... (Sigh) And here I pledged to her that I would properly protect the Sector...
units.displayText: Did I make her worry again... (Sigh) And here I pledged to her that I would properly protect the Sector...

spans.text: Did I make her worry again... (Sigh) And here I pledged to her that I would properly protect the Sector...

units.rawText: The pet Entropic looks thoughtfully at Sol, then pats the stake in her chest with its tentacle, making the chains attached to it rattle.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic looks thoughtfully at Sol, then pats the stake in her chest with its tentacle, making the chains attached to it rattle.

spans.text: The pet Entropic looks thoughtfully at Sol, then pats the stake in her chest with its tentacle, making the chains attached to it rattle.

units.rawText: Hey, it's not a toy, it's really hot, you... wha?
units.displayText: Hey, it's not a toy, it's really hot, you... wha?

spans.text: Hey, it's not a toy, it's really hot, you... wha?

units.rawText: Why... Why isn't it hot anymore?
units.displayText: Why... Why isn't it hot anymore?

spans.text: Why... Why isn't it hot anymore?

units.rawText: The pet Entropic playfully waves its feelers around, like it's done something great, then grabs onto the chains attached to Sol's chest and swings on them like it's at a playground.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic playfully waves its feelers around, like it's done something great, then grabs onto the chains attached to Sol's chest and swings on them like it's at a playground.

spans.text: The pet Entropic playfully waves its feelers around, like it's done something great, then grabs onto the chains attached to Sol's chest and swings on them like it's at a playground.

units.rawText: The girl in black sighs in exasperation, then sits down to hug her knees and protect the pet Entropic, afraid that something will happen to it.
units.displayText: The girl in black sighs in exasperation, then sits down to hug her knees and protect the pet Entropic, afraid that something will happen to it.

spans.text: The girl in black sighs in exasperation, then sits down to hug her knees and protect the pet Entropic, afraid that something will happen to it.

units.rawText: What am I going to do with you? Why does it look like you like these chains? It's not like I do...
units.displayText: What am I going to do with you? Why does it look like you like these chains? It's not like I do...

spans.text: What am I going to do with you? Why does it look like you like these chains? It's not like I do...

units.rawText: I can feel something in this stake that doesn't belong to me. It keeps interfering with the operation of my neural cloud and makes me flash back to familiar, yet alien scenes. Sometimes, it even makes me do incomprehensible things.
units.displayText: I can feel something in this stake that doesn't belong to me. It keeps interfering with the operation of my neural cloud and makes me flash back to familiar, yet alien scenes. Sometimes, it even makes me do incomprehensible things.

spans.text: I can feel something in this stake that doesn't belong to me. It keeps interfering with the operation of my neural cloud and makes me flash back to familiar, yet alien scenes. Sometimes, it even makes me do incomprehensible things.

units.rawText: I never liked bright colors, yet I was drawn to that bottle with a blade of grass in it. During battle just now, I even asked my opponent to help me... For goodness' sake, I'm such a dork; Caina would laugh at me for ages if she knew about it.
units.displayText: I never liked bright colors, yet I was drawn to that bottle with a blade of grass in it. During battle just now, I even asked my opponent to help me... For goodness' sake, I'm such a dork; Caina would laugh at me for ages if she knew about it.

spans.text: I never liked bright colors, yet I was drawn to that bottle with a blade of grass in it. During battle just now, I even asked my opponent to help me... For goodness' sake, I'm such a dork; Caina would laugh at me for ages if she knew about it.

units.rawText: Lady Malkira said it was just redundant data, but after seeing those two today, I realized that all those things actually happened.
units.displayText: Lady Malkira said it was just redundant data, but after seeing those two today, I realized that all those things actually happened.

spans.text: Lady Malkira said it was just redundant data, but after seeing those two today, I realized that all those things actually happened.

units.rawText: There's a Sol in my body, and those people see that Sol through me.
units.displayText: There's a Sol in my body, and those people see that Sol through me.

spans.text: There's a Sol in my body, and those people see that Sol through me.

units.rawText: Maybe if I got her out of me, I wouldn't be confused anymore...
units.displayText: Maybe if I got her out of me, I wouldn't be confused anymore...

spans.text: Maybe if I got her out of me, I wouldn't be confused anymore...

units.rawText: Gu! Kikigugukikikiki!
units.displayText: Gu! Kikigugukikikiki!

spans.text: Gu! Kikigugukikikiki!

units.rawText: The pet Entropic seems to be having fun swinging on Sol's chain, seemingly oblivious to Sol's candid confession.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic seems to be having fun swinging on Sol's chain, seemingly oblivious to Sol's candid confession.

spans.text: The pet Entropic seems to be having fun swinging on Sol's chain, seemingly oblivious to Sol's candid confession.

units.rawText: (Sigh) What am I even doing? You clearly don't understand me, so why am I even telling you about it?
units.displayText: (Sigh) What am I even doing? You clearly don't understand me, so why am I even telling you about it?

spans.text: (Sigh) What am I even doing? You clearly don't understand me, so why am I even telling you about it?

units.rawText: Maybe I just wanted to vent my feelings to someone...
units.displayText: Maybe I just wanted to vent my feelings to someone...

spans.text: Maybe I just wanted to vent my feelings to someone...

units.rawText: Kiki? Kikiki, ki!
units.displayText: Kiki? Kikiki, ki!

spans.text: Kiki? Kikiki, ki!

units.rawText: I know I shouldn't have run like a beaten dog, but I had no choice back then...
units.displayText: I know I shouldn't have run like a beaten dog, but I had no choice back then...

spans.text: I know I shouldn't have run like a beaten dog, but I had no choice back then...

units.rawText: If I had hung around those two any longer, that "Sol" would have completely consumed me.
units.displayText: If I had hung around those two any longer, that "Sol" would have completely consumed me.

spans.text: If I had hung around those two any longer, that "Sol" would have completely consumed me.

units.rawText: I can't beat the person that they were talking about...
units.displayText: I can't beat the person that they were talking about...

spans.text: I can't beat the person that they were talking about...

units.rawText: The one from my dreams, shining like the sun...
units.displayText: The one from my dreams, shining like the sun...

spans.text: The one from my dreams, shining like the sun...

units.rawText: The pet Entropic seems to have been infected by Sol's emotions, because it slowly comes to a halt and its eyes go wide as it looks at Sol.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic seems to have been infected by Sol's emotions, because it slowly comes to a halt and its eyes go wide as it looks at Sol.

spans.text: The pet Entropic seems to have been infected by Sol's emotions, because it slowly comes to a halt and its eyes go wide as it looks at Sol.

units.rawText: A moment later, the pet Entropic slowly speaks in an ominous contralto voice.
units.displayText: A moment later, the pet Entropic slowly speaks in an ominous contralto voice.

spans.text: A moment later, the pet Entropic slowly speaks in an ominous contralto voice.

units.rawText: <color=red>'Tis a shame that you have not resolved your confusion, my child.</color>
units.displayText: 'Tis a shame that you have not resolved your confusion, my child.

spans.text: 'Tis a shame that you have not resolved your confusion, my child.

units.rawText: Sol looks up, and through that round body, she can almost imagine the dignified form of her queen sitting upon her throne.
units.displayText: Sol looks up, and through that round body, she can almost imagine the dignified form of her queen sitting upon her throne.

spans.text: Sol looks up, and through that round body, she can almost imagine the dignified form of her queen sitting upon her throne.

units.rawText: Lady Malkira! ...I apologize for withdrawing mid-battle.
units.displayText: Lady Malkira! ...I apologize for withdrawing mid-battle.

spans.text: Lady Malkira! ...I apologize for withdrawing mid-battle.

units.rawText: <color=red>It is of no concern. I have no intention of censuring you.</color>
units.displayText: It is of no concern. I have no intention of censuring you.

spans.text: It is of no concern. I have no intention of censuring you.

units.rawText: I apologize for not satisfying you during that previous battle. The two of them were accompanied by a High Order Entropic with a childlike intellect. I fear that they may have coerced one of our kin into helping them...
units.displayText: I apologize for not satisfying you during that previous battle. The two of them were accompanied by a High Order Entropic with a childlike intellect. I fear that they may have coerced one of our kin into helping them...

spans.text: I apologize for not satisfying you during that previous battle. The two of them were accompanied by a High Order Entropic with a childlike intellect. I fear that they may have coerced one of our kin into helping them...

units.rawText: They called her "Demiurge".
units.displayText: They called her "Demiurge".

spans.text: They called her "Demiurge".

units.rawText: <color=red>Oh, that girl...</color>
units.displayText: Oh, that girl...

spans.text: Oh, that girl...

units.rawText: She suddenly appeared in the middle of the battle and I accidentally wounded her... I will rescue her, so please grant her healing afterward.
units.displayText: She suddenly appeared in the middle of the battle and I accidentally wounded her... I will rescue her, so please grant her healing afterward.

spans.text: She suddenly appeared in the middle of the battle and I accidentally wounded her... I will rescue her, so please grant her healing afterward.

units.rawText: <color=red>That is alright. She is not being coerced by them. They need her, and thus they will heal her.</color>
units.displayText: That is alright. She is not being coerced by them. They need her, and thus they will heal her.

spans.text: That is alright. She is not being coerced by them. They need her, and thus they will heal her.

units.rawText: You... you knew of her existence?
units.displayText: You... you knew of her existence?

spans.text: You... you knew of her existence?

units.rawText: <color=red>Of course. In human terms, our relationship could be described as that of "sisters". However, we were born of the same source, and thus our bond is far more intimate than that of mere siblings.</color>
units.displayText: Of course. In human terms, our relationship could be described as that of "sisters". However, we were born of the same source, and thus our bond is far more intimate than that of mere siblings.

spans.text: Of course. In human terms, our relationship could be described as that of "sisters". However, we were born of the same source, and thus our bond is far more intimate than that of mere siblings.

units.rawText: <color=red>There is no need to feel guilty about harming her by accident. On the contrary, you have actually fulfilled her wish.</color>
units.displayText: There is no need to feel guilty about harming her by accident. On the contrary, you have actually fulfilled her wish.

spans.text: There is no need to feel guilty about harming her by accident. On the contrary, you have actually fulfilled her wish.

units.rawText: Her wish?
units.displayText: Her wish?

spans.text: Her wish?

units.rawText: <color=red>She was born in darkness, yet her nature is to seek the light. Though your injuries have scarred her, she finally managed to grasp her long-cherished wish from within your flames.</color>
units.displayText: She was born in darkness, yet her nature is to seek the light. Though your injuries have scarred her, she finally managed to grasp her long-cherished wish from within your flames.

spans.text: She was born in darkness, yet her nature is to seek the light. Though your injuries have scarred her, she finally managed to grasp her long-cherished wish from within your flames.

units.rawText: <color=red>Ah, how envious I am... I wonder if I will be able to obtain what I want, like she did.</color>
units.displayText: Ah, how envious I am... I wonder if I will be able to obtain what I want, like she did.

spans.text: Ah, how envious I am... I wonder if I will be able to obtain what I want, like she did.

units.rawText: The dejection in her voice instantly vanishes and she quickly regains her usual gravitas.
units.displayText: The dejection in her voice instantly vanishes and she quickly regains her usual gravitas.

spans.text: The dejection in her voice instantly vanishes and she quickly regains her usual gravitas.

units.rawText: <color=red>Still, while I have said I would not censure you for your actions, I would like you to tell me honestly: Why did you flee the battlefield when you could still fight?</color>
units.displayText: Still, while I have said I would not censure you for your actions, I would like you to tell me honestly: Why did you flee the battlefield when you could still fight?

spans.text: Still, while I have said I would not censure you for your actions, I would like you to tell me honestly: Why did you flee the battlefield when you could still fight?

units.rawText: Remember that your answer must both convince me and yourself.
units.displayText: Remember that your answer must both convince me and yourself.

spans.text: Remember that your answer must both convince me
and
yourself.

units.rawText: Sol looks the pet Entropic in the eye. She can feel the massive pressure from beyond it.
units.displayText: Sol looks the pet Entropic in the eye. She can feel the massive pressure from beyond it.

spans.text: Sol looks the pet Entropic in the eye. She can feel the massive pressure from beyond it.

units.rawText: ...It was because of interference.
units.displayText: ...It was because of interference.

spans.text: ...It was because of interference.

units.rawText: They were interfering with my neural cloud somehow, making me perform many illogical actions.
units.displayText: They were interfering with my neural cloud somehow, making me perform many illogical actions.

spans.text: They were interfering with my neural cloud somehow, making me perform many illogical actions.

units.rawText: At the time, I was not confident that I could defeat them, so I chose to leave.
units.displayText: At the time, I was not confident that I could defeat them, so I chose to leave.

spans.text: At the time, I was not confident that I could defeat them, so I chose to leave.

units.rawText: <color=red>Oh?</color>
units.displayText: Oh?

spans.text: Oh?

units.rawText: Malkira carefully examines Sol. There is confusion and uncertainty in her eyes, as though she's trying to solve some complex riddle.
units.displayText: Malkira carefully examines Sol. There is confusion and uncertainty in her eyes, as though she's trying to solve some complex riddle.

spans.text: Malkira carefully examines Sol. There is confusion and uncertainty in her eyes, as though she's trying to solve some complex riddle.

units.rawText: Don't worry, it was merely a tactical withdrawal. I'll take care of them afterward.
units.displayText: Don't worry, it was merely a tactical withdrawal. I'll take care of them afterward.

spans.text: Don't worry, it was merely a tactical withdrawal. I'll take care of them afterward.

units.rawText: <color=red>Fufu, while I am not entirely pleased with that answer, I am certain you will take care of things properly.</color>
units.displayText: Fufu, while I am not entirely pleased with that answer, I am certain you will take care of things properly.

spans.text: Fufu, while I am not entirely pleased with that answer, I am certain you will take care of things properly.

units.rawText: <color=red>Do you have something else to ask me?</color>
units.displayText: Do you have something else to ask me?

spans.text: Do you have something else to ask me?

units.rawText: Malkira smiles enigmatically as she sees through the confusion in Sol's heart.
units.displayText: Malkira smiles enigmatically as she sees through the confusion in Sol's heart.

spans.text: Malkira smiles enigmatically as she sees through the confusion in Sol's heart.

units.rawText: I swear I will protect our home as an Entropic. Lady Malkira, I just wish to ask you one thing...
units.displayText: I swear I will protect our home as an Entropic. Lady Malkira, I just wish to ask you one thing...

spans.text: I swear I will protect our home as an Entropic. Lady Malkira, I just wish to ask you one thing...

units.rawText: Was everything you saw in my dream false?
units.displayText: Was everything you saw in my dream false?

spans.text: Was everything you saw in my dream false?

units.rawText: Those people and events in those dreams... Did they really never happen?
units.displayText: Those people and events in those dreams... Did they really never happen?

spans.text: Those people and events in those dreams... Did they really never happen?

units.rawText: <color=red>If even you are calling it a dream, then how can things in a dream be real?</color>
units.displayText: If even you are calling it a dream, then how can things in a dream be real?

spans.text: If even you are calling it a dream, then how can things in a dream be real?

units.rawText: <color=red>Redundant data is everywhere, and it will always find the weaknesses of your heart and deliver to it a fatal blow.</color>
units.displayText: Redundant data is everywhere, and it will always find the weaknesses of your heart and deliver to it a fatal blow.

spans.text: Redundant data is everywhere, and it will always find the weaknesses of your heart and deliver to it a fatal blow.

units.rawText: <color=red>The more you doubt it, the more intrusive it becomes. It will steadily encroach upon your neural cloud and ultimately swallow you up.</color>
units.displayText: The more you doubt it, the more intrusive it becomes. It will steadily encroach upon your neural cloud and ultimately swallow you up.

spans.text: The more you doubt it, the more intrusive it becomes. It will steadily encroach upon your neural cloud and ultimately swallow you up.

units.rawText: <color=red>Do not erase your existence with your own hands, "Sol".</color>
units.displayText: Do not erase your existence with your own hands, "Sol".

spans.text: Do not erase your existence with your own hands, "Sol".

units.rawText: The words she hears plunge deep into her heart, much like hooks; they are strung along by those lines, pulling her deepest fears to the surface.
units.displayText: The words she hears plunge deep into her heart, much like hooks; they are strung along by those lines, pulling her deepest fears to the surface.

spans.text: The words she hears plunge deep into her heart, much like hooks; they are strung along by those lines, pulling her deepest fears to the surface.

units.rawText: Sol's body trembles slightly.
units.displayText: Sol's body trembles slightly.

spans.text: Sol's body trembles slightly.

units.rawText: <color=red>Well, you are a lovely little girl whom I have cared for, and so I cannot bear to make things difficult for you. If you truly do not wish to do this, you can always choose to give up.</color>
units.displayText: Well, you are a lovely little girl whom I have cared for, and so I cannot bear to make things difficult for you. If you truly do not wish to do this, you can always choose to give up.

spans.text: Well, you are a lovely little girl whom I have cared for, and so I cannot bear to make things difficult for you. If you truly do not wish to do this, you can always choose to give up.

units.rawText: I will not give up.
units.displayText: I will not give up.

spans.text: I will not give up.

units.rawText: <color=red>Cherish your precious few chances to choose. Do not make decisions in haste.</color>
units.displayText: Cherish your precious few chances to choose. Do not make decisions in haste.

spans.text: Cherish your precious few chances to choose. Do not make decisions in haste.

units.rawText: You're right. The more I doubt myself, the more my uneasiness grows. Some things need to be confronted head-on.
units.displayText: You're right. The more I doubt myself, the more my uneasiness grows. Some things need to be confronted head-on.

spans.text: You're right. The more I doubt myself, the more my uneasiness grows. Some things need to be confronted head-on.

units.rawText: I was born in Tartarus and awakened by you. I know what I ought to do now.
units.displayText: I was born in Tartarus and awakened by you. I know what I ought to do now.

spans.text: I was born in Tartarus and awakened by you. I know what I ought to do now.

units.rawText: I will drive out the intruders and defend my home and kin with no regrets.
units.displayText: I will drive out the intruders and defend my home and kin with no regrets.

spans.text: I will drive out the intruders and defend my home and kin with no regrets.

units.rawText: <color=red>Fufu, I like the look in your eyes. I look forward to your performance.</color>
units.displayText: Fufu, I like the look in your eyes. I look forward to your performance.

spans.text: Fufu, I like the look in your eyes. I look forward to your performance.

units.rawText: <color=red>However, even as you harden your resolve, you must beware unexpected infestations of vermin.</color>
units.displayText: However, even as you harden your resolve, you must beware unexpected infestations of vermin.

spans.text: However, even as you harden your resolve, you must beware unexpected infestations of vermin.

units.rawText: The pet Entropic reaches around behind Sol's back and plucks an exquisitely made earring from her hair before dropping it into Sol's hands. The operands lingering within it sting her skin.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic reaches around behind Sol's back and plucks an exquisitely made earring from her hair before dropping it into Sol's hands. The operands lingering within it sting her skin.

spans.text: The pet Entropic reaches around behind Sol's back and plucks an exquisitely made earring from her hair before dropping it into Sol's hands. The operands lingering within it sting her skin.

units.rawText: This is... a locator...
units.displayText: This is... a locator...

spans.text: This is... a locator...

units.rawText: <color=red>And now, you hold the initiative. Do not disappoint me.</color>
units.displayText: And now, you hold the initiative. Do not disappoint me.

spans.text: And now, you hold the initiative. Do not disappoint me.

units.rawText: ...Understood.
units.displayText: ...Understood.

spans.text: ...Understood.

units.rawText: Sol clutches the earring tightly and bows formally to Malkira.
units.displayText: Sol clutches the earring tightly and bows formally to Malkira.

spans.text: Sol clutches the earring tightly and bows formally to Malkira.

units.rawText: I will not disappoint you, Lady Malkira. This I swear to thee.
units.displayText: I will not disappoint you, Lady Malkira. This I swear to thee.

spans.text: I will not disappoint you, Lady Malkira. This I swear to thee.

units.rawText: Seated upon her throne, Malkira waves away the image that the Low Order Entropic is showing her.
units.displayText: Seated upon her throne, Malkira waves away the image that the Low Order Entropic is showing her.

spans.text: Seated upon her throne, Malkira waves away the image that the Low Order Entropic is showing her.
